label: NFHS Basketball, sub-varsity (generic U.S. high school JV/middle school)

_source_notes.period.format: Scoping doc Sec.4.3 flags sub-varsity/middle-school levels as running '6-minute quarters or halves' -- genuinely uncertain WHICH shape (quarters vs halves) a given sub-varsity level uses. This document assumes quarters (matching varsity's own structure, just shorter) as the safer default since it changes fewer downstream assumptions (team-foul-per-quarter reset, bonus scope) than switching to halves would. Needs owner confirmation before this stops being a placeholder; a level that actually uses halves needs its own further overlay.
_source_notes.period.length_seconds: 360 (6:00) per quarter is the commonly-cited sub-varsity/JV length the scoping doc names (Sec.4.3) -- not yet confirmed against a specific MHSAA sub-varsity rule, and this document is not itself resolved by any (country, region, association, sport) catalog tuple yet (see ruleset_service._CATALOG -- no sub-varsity row exists in P0); it exists so the shape is ready once a level/classification concept selects it.
